Authored in Encounter

Readable Encounter source is authoritative. The existing algebra-owned process frontend compiles all 23 queries into the JSON module used by the normal lowerer and kernel.

The selected process profile covers let, when, port, fold/yield, assert/otherwise, call and try/catch, with the existing operators and dotted references. It does not introduce another interpreter or change the kernel budget.

The authority switch followed exact ordered JSON correspondence, whole-module lowering equality, source-coordinate coverage, behaviour/effect/fault comparisons and refusal checks. A pinned predecessor supplies compiler bootstrap only; application definitions come from this readable source.
